object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Between two commits, change one field at a time: an attribute value; an attribute set and another unset; the description; a link added; a link removed; a link's type; a table added, changed and removed; a figure added, replaced and removed; then several fields at once. Also compare an uncommitted edit with the latest commit. Expected: each changed object is reported as Modified, and not as Link reviewed, with the field that changed.
